# Boolean logic: not is a builtin; and/or are short-circuit special forms.

=== not true
(not #t)
--- want
#f

=== not false
(not #f)
--- want
#t

=== not needs a bool
(not 1)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== not arity
(not)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== and true
(and #t #t)
--- want
#t

=== and false
(and #t #f)
--- want
#f

=== and empty is true
(and)
--- want
#t

=== and single
(and #t)
--- want
#t

=== and variadic
(and #t #t #t #f)
--- want
#f

=== and needs bools
(and 1)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== and short-circuits past an error
(and #f (/ 1 0))
--- want
#f

=== and evaluates the tail when needed
(and #t (/ 1 0))
--- error
--- at 1:9

=== or true
(or #f #t)
--- want
#t

=== or false
(or #f #f)
--- want
#f

=== or empty is false
(or)
--- want
#f

=== or short-circuits past an error
(or #t (/ 1 0))
--- want
#t

=== or evaluates the tail when needed
(or #f (/ 1 0))
--- error
--- at 1:8

=== or tail must be a bool
(or #f 1)
--- error
--- at 1:1
